title: Messenger Account Hijack in practice
intro: The six-digit code is your account key. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Message from Department group
decisions.prompt: A message comes to the group from your head of department's account. What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: Department group
body: Elnarə Hüseynova: Hello all. I urgently need 300 manat, I will pay it back tonight.
Elnarə Hüseynova: I will send the card number privately. Do not call, I am in a meeting.

options.label: I will send it, write the card

decisions.explain: Calling the number you know shows at once who wrote the message.

decisions.title: Drawing contest vote
decisions.prompt: A link from a friend opened this page. What do you do?

artifact.title: Vote for Leyla's drawing
body: Children's drawing contest. Leyla is in second place!
To vote, sign in with your Söhbət account.

decisions.explain: Closing an unknown page that wants an account for a vote is the safest step.

decisions.title: Message from Aysel Məmmədova
decisions.prompt: A minute later a message comes from your friend Aysel. What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: Aysel Məmmədova
body: Hi dear, did you get a code? I sent mine to your number by mistake.
Please send it quickly, my phone is getting blocked.

decisions.explain: A code that came to you belongs to your account, and the call warns the real Aysel.

decisions.title: Söhbət: Two-step verification turned on
decisions.prompt: Is this notice safe or a threat?

artifact.title: Söhbət: Two-step verification turned on
body: You set up extra protection for your account.

decisions.explain: This confirms a step you took yourself. Two-step verification protects the account from code theft.

decisions.title: Message from Söhbət
decisions.prompt: Is this notice safe or a threat?

artifact.name: Söhbət
body: Your Söhbət code: 418 205. Do not share this code with anyone.

decisions.explain: If you did not ask for it, someone is trying to log in with your number. Give the code to no one.
